name: lightboard
title: Lightboard
description: A wide grid of small dots renders blocky amber text that scrolls sideways like an LED sign; drawing can be enabled to light individual dots by hand.
use: You want a retro LED sign effect or a scrolling announcement strip that draws the eye.
avoid: The text scrolls forever and pauses only on hover; it is unreadable to screen readers and needs a wide container.
a11y: The canvas has no accessible text or label and scrolls continuously, ignoring reduced-motion preferences. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A long black rectangular panel filled with a fine grid of dim dots, with chunky amber letters lit out of them. The message sits centred vertically in the band, with dark margins around the sign.
behaves: The message crawls right to left on a fixed interval and wraps forever. Hovering pauses it; when drawing is enabled, dragging lights dots along the pointer path.
customise: text, rows, light size, gap, font, speed and dot colours are props; the glyph font and scroll direction are fixed in the source.
weight: heavy: The canvas is repainted on every animation frame, redrawing about 1,400 dots.
